selection.negativeIndicatorCaveat: Case-level nonempty predictions on unavailable/context-only probes; not a count of semantically wrong lexical links.

definitions.eligibleUnits: Unique exact-span prepared context units; structural headings/original-title spans and standalone Roman controls excluded. Equal text at different offsets counts separately.
definitions.pairedUnits: Entire original UTF16 unit span contained in the union of active non-lexical groups.parts[locale]. Alias-only groups never count as unit pairs; groups without parts do not contribute.
definitions.eligibleWords: Unique exact spans from artifact.editions[locale].words containing a Unicode letter and wholly within ONE eligible context unit. No word lookup calls are made.
definitions.anyRawLinkWords: Eligible words overlapping the union of raw source-side link spans from all active groups, including lexical aliases; no confidence threshold. Partial/unlinked partition uses raw overlap.
definitions.fullLetterWords: Every Unicode letter/mark UTF16 code unit inside an eligible word is covered by raw link-span union. Spaces/punctuation ignored; combining marks included; astral letters count two UTF16 units.
definitions.unitPercentageDenominator: eligibleUnits; paired unit percent is source pairing coverage, not semantic accuracy.
definitions.wordPercentageDenominator: eligibleWords; full/partial/unlinked are disjoint and sum to eligibleWords. Raw punctuation-only overlap is partial and recorded by linkedButNoLetterWords.
definitions.uiStrictMatchPct: 100*uiStatuses.match/uiQueriedUnits. Only full original unit quotes<=2000 UTF16 units are queried; errors and stale/pending/missing remain in denominator and never pass.
definitions.uiHighlightStatusPct: 100*(match+uncertain)/uiQueriedUnits; this is UI status coverage, not word confidence or correctness.
definitions.uiContextStatusPct: 100*(match+uncertain+context-only)/uiQueriedUnits; this includes context-only answers and is not strict matching.
definitions.exclusions: uiTooLongUnits are listed separately, excluded only from UI query denominators. Input and artifact source revision/version/hash/text/breaks must agree, and all40 source files are rehashed after reporting.
definitions.limitation: Entirely automatic structural/link inventory and full-unit UI statuses. These percentages are NOT semantic accuracy, translation quality, or a manual every-word review.
